text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Zimbabwean President Robert Mugabe has dismissed criticism of a deal sanctioned by his government under which part of the Hwange Thermal Power Station will be sold to a Malaysian company.
- Zimbabwe's premier computer fair, IT '96, opened in Harare on Monday with exhibitors emphasising the idea of incorporating the developing world into the global village within their themes.
